nodes.text:
Here we go again. 
‘An outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in China has raised alarm globally.’
It’s surreal how half the world’s population can be fooled by this while the other half knows exactly what’s going on and why. Can’t wait until everyone knows the truth. Soon.
